title: Unorthodox Bro Split
author: Philip G.
desc:
Perfect for experienced lifters who are looking to try body part split that is slightly different than traditional programs. 

Legs will be split up into two days and some shoulder spread throughout the training week. 

Feel free to add shrugs or more claves and abs where you see fit. 

I usually use dynamic or double progression methods. Occasionally I will go to failure on the last set and if I get 2+ reps than my rep goal I will add weight next week.

ex.note: Use any main chest movement you prefer. I stick to machines due to elbow issues.
Also known as barrel press. Check YouTube for form tips.
1-2 drop sets to failure on the last set.
Single arm and lean away from the arm in use. So if using left arm lean to your right on an angle and brace yourself with on a wall.
I prefer a straight bar or cambered bar.
Cable machine. Keep the pulley high up and keep your elbow behind your body
1.5 reps: Down, half way up, back down then back up is one full rep.
Sissy leg press (YouTube this for form if you’re unsure). Start off light if it’s a a new movement.
Put the seat back as far as you can (comfortably) and feel the insane stretch in the quads.
I do half range of motion. Fully down and up until your foot is at the starting position/ankle at 90 degrees.
Swap with any weighted ab exercise you may prefer.
Really focus on engaging the last it will help the rest of the session.
Focus on setting yourself up to have your hand, elbow and lats all in line with the angle of the cable. Just like in the icon for this exercise.
